profile: validation set: A random portion of data is removed to validate a model. It can be a batch of previously unseen images of cats and dogs, used to see how well the model identifies the animal in each image. This removed portion is commonly called validation data or validation set.

draft.profile: validation set: A portion of data set aside to evaluate a trained model. It consists of previously unseen examples, such as images of cats and dogs, used to test how accurately the model identifies each animal. The validation data is commonly a randomly removed subset of the original data, employed to validate one or more models.
